newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse closes higher in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse closes higher in active trade.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Tuesday 0.38 percent higher as main stocks pursued their upward trend in active trade, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 505.27 points from 503.36 points on Friday.
"We expected the index to pause after having steadily risen since early this year but the trade is still active " a broker at Maroc Services Intermediations said.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, Morocco's second largest private conglomerate which holds diversified stakes in more than 40 firms, fell 14 dirhams to 590 dirhams.
The conglomerate has a market capitalisation of more than 5.6 billion dirhams.
Dairy firm Centrale Laitiere took 30 dirhams to 2030 dirhams. French group Danone holds 20 percent stake in the concern.
"The stock is very illiquid, that's why it has a tendency to rise sharply," he added.
In the banking sector, Banque Commerciale du Maroc, one of Morocco's largest banks, rose 15 dirhams to close at 735 dirhams.
Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique gained six dirhams to close at 178 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie was up eight dirhams to 370 dirhams.
Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, a blue chip stock, shed four dirhams to trade at 446 dirhams.
Samir oil refinery, the country's main refinery, gained eight dirhams to close at 260 dirhams.
Newly-floated Credor dipped 18 dirhams to close at 593 dirhams.
Traded volume on the official market was 76.5 million dirhams, up from 48.7 million on Friday.
